name: How long does it take to restore historic windows, especially for an entire house?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to restore historic windows, especially for an entire house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for historic window restoration depends on the number of windows, their condition, and the complexity of repairs. A single window might take several days of dedicated work, while a whole-house project for a typical home in Eagle or Kuna could span several weeks to a few months. We often work on windows in batches to minimize disruption, ensuring your home remains secure and weather-tight throughout the project. Our team provides a detailed project schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time varies by window count and condition, from days for one window to months for a whole house. We schedule projects in batches.
